thread:
alex: Hey payroll team — my Feb 15 net pay looks off. I moved my residential address from PA -> NJ on Feb 10 and expected PA withholding to stop, but paycheck shows local PA tax still withheld. Can someone check? Payslip: https://payroll.redwood/payslips/AX-2026-02

payroll-bot: New ticket created: PR-2026-482. Assigned to @jenna-payroll. ETA initial review 1 business day.

jenna-payroll: Looking. Quick Q: did you update home address in Workday and submit the req transfer form? That determines effective withholding date.

alex: yes updated Workday on Feb 9 and filed the internal transfer form on Feb 9 (HR confirmed). I also attached a PDF in the ticket.

maria-hr: Confirming I approved the internal transfer on Feb 9. Residency change effective date in HR is 2026-02-10.

jenna-payroll: Thanks — payroll system processes withholding rules by pay period cutoffs. Because the move was mid-pay period (pay period 2/1–2/15), PA tax applied for days worked in PA. We need to calculate pro-rata withholding or do an off-cycle correction.

payroll: To proceed we need: (1) copy of new NJ driver's license or lease (proof of residency), (2) confirmation of remote work days after 2/10. Please reply here or upload to ticket PR-2026-482.

alex: uploaded lease scan to the ticket. I worked remotely from NJ starting 2/11. 

jenna-payroll: Great. We'll run an off-cycle gross-up correction to refund the PA local withholding for the NJ days. This will appear as an off-cycle pay run (no change to base pay). Expect the reversal on next off-cycle (target 5 business days). W-2 impact: If the correction occurs in the same calendar year, it's included on the original W-2; if after year-end we'll issue a W-2c. We'll confirm once processed.

sam-eng: tagging FYI — if this affects tax withholding for other folks who did internal transfers, is there a checklist we can point folks to?

maria-hr: I'll add a short checklist to the relocation/transfer docs: update Workday, upload proof, note residency effective date, tell payroll in Slack.

alex: Thanks! Appreciate the quick triage. Please confirm when PR-2026-482 is closed.

jenna-payroll: Will do. I'll post the final payroll confirmation here once the off-cycle posts. :thumbsup:
